question: Is the coefficient's action divergence concentrated in drop/promotion moves?

move_classification.promotion: move text starts with 'BoardMove(' and contains a non-None promotion_target_id
move_classification.quiet: move text starts with 'BoardMove(' and contains promotion_target_id=None
move_classification.other: anything else; must be 0 for the tally to be reported

completion_derivation.one_truncated: exactly one oracle reason in {node_limit, qsearch_check_hard_limit}

checks_before_reporting: verdict totals match the stored aggregate (served_better 13, blind_better 28, tie 4)
pair-kind group totals match the stored aggregate (divergent_split 24, config_decided 21)
saved move text is non-empty for both sides

endpoints_written_in_advance.primary: counts of cells whose first-divergence pair involves at least one drop, at least one promotion, and neither (quiet-vs-quiet); counts of class-changing pairs (served class != blind class)
endpoints_written_in_advance.concentration_threshold: report 'caution applies' if class-changing pairs >= 15 of 45 (one third), otherwise report 'divergence mostly quiet-move sensitivity'; state the number either way
endpoints_written_in_advance.secondary: cross-tabulate pair class against group, verdict and completion stratum, with exact cell counts only
endpoints_written_in_advance.no_baseline_claim: no legal-move population baseline is computed here; drop/promotion frequency among chosen moves is not compared to their availability in the position

limits_to_state: Descriptive tally only; no search, no new evaluation, no strength or utility inference.
Cells are correlated (10 duplicate positions across depths, colour-swapped pairs); exact counts are not independent samples.
A class label says what the first differing move was, not why the coefficient changed it.
Absence of a drop/promotion difference does not show the search ignores promotion, capture-to-base or drop transitions.
Truncation strata are inherited from the stored oracle reasons, not re-verified here.

output.overwrite_guard: refuse if the result path already exists
